claim_context: Retention is material. At an assumed 2 KB per response, 100,000 responses contain about 0.2 GB before indexes and database overhead. At D1’s published $0.75/GB-month beyond allowances, that payload alone is about $0.15 per month, or $1.80 for a year. This illustrative calculation shows why a one-time $1 payment cannot casually include permanent hot storage. Archiving can change the model but must be separately costed. [D1 storage pricing](https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/platform/pricing/).
